config.script:
selectedPath = self.getSibling("DD_ScreenSel").props.value
	selectedRoles = self.getSibling("DD_RoleSel").props.value
	
	if not selectedPath or not selectedRoles:
	    return
	
	# Convert Multi-Select value to normal Python list
	selectedRoles = [str(role) for role in selectedRoles]
	
	# Convert Session Tree from ArrayWrapper to normal Python objects
	tree = system.util.jsonDecode(
	    system.util.jsonEncode(self.session.custom.treeItems)
	)
	
	
	def findNodeByPath(nodes, path):
	
	    for node in nodes:
	
	        if node.get("data", {}).get("path") == path:
	            return node
	
	        result = findNodeByPath(
	            node.get("items", []),
	            path
	        )
	
	        if result:
	            return result
	
	    return None
	
	
	# ----------------------------------
	# Update Tree Node Roles
	# ----------------------------------
	
	targetNode = findNodeByPath(tree, selectedPath)
	
	if not targetNode:
	
	    system.util.getLogger("RBAC").warn(
	        "Node not found: {}".format(selectedPath)
	    )
	    return
	
	# Replace existing roles
	targetNode["data"]["roles"] = selectedRoles
	
	# Save updated tree back to Session
	self.session.custom.treeItems = tree
	
	
	# ----------------------------------
	# Update RBAC Table
	# ----------------------------------
	
	table = self.getSibling("Table")
	tableData = list(table.props.data or [])
	
	screenName = targetNode.get("label")
	
	found = False
	
	for row in tableData:
	
	    if row["ScreenName"] == screenName:
	
	        row["UserRoles"] = ", ".join(selectedRoles)
	        found = True
	        break
	
	if not found:
	
	    tableData.append({
	        "ScreenName": screenName,
	        "UserRoles": ", ".join(selectedRoles)
	    })
	
	table.props.data = tableData
	
	
	# ----------------------------------
	# Logging
	# ----------------------------------
	
	system.util.getLogger("RBAC").info(
	    "Updated '{}' with roles {}".format(
	        screenName,
	        selectedRoles
	    )
	)

# Get selected row index
	table = self.getSibling("Table")
	
	selectedRow = table.props.selection.selectedRow
	
	if selectedRow is None or selectedRow < 0:
	    return
	
	tableData = list(table.props.data or [])
	
	selectedRecord = tableData[selectedRow]
	
	screenName = selectedRecord["ScreenName"]
	
	# ----------------------------------
	# Update Tree
	# ----------------------------------
	
	tree = system.util.jsonDecode(
	    system.util.jsonEncode(self.session.custom.treeItems)
	)
	
	
	def findNodeByLabel(nodes, label):
	
	    for node in nodes:
	
	        if node.get("label") == label:
	            return node
	
	        result = findNodeByLabel(
	            node.get("items", []),
	            label
	        )
	
	        if result:
	            return result
	
	    return None
	
	
	targetNode = findNodeByLabel(tree, screenName)
	
	if targetNode:
	
	    targetNode["data"]["roles"] = []
	
	    self.session.custom.treeItems = tree
	
	# ----------------------------------
	# Remove Row From Table
	# ----------------------------------
	
	tableData.pop(selectedRow)
	
	table.props.data = tableData
	
	# Clear selection
	table.props.selection.selectedRow = -1
	
	system.util.getLogger("RBAC").info(
	    "Removed all access from '{}'".format(screenName)
	)
